claims.body: The Mammoth are near the top of the league for chance quality, but the Kraken are near the top at preventing dangerous shots. We’ll side with the Mammoth.

notes.text: Cale Fleury has not dressed for the last 4 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Brandon Montour is out (lower body injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is a top-four defenseman.
Vince Dunn has started killing penalties: on the ice for 39% of the team’s shorthanded time in 8 games, up from 2% last season.

SEA.head: The Kraken face a real test
SEA.body: Even though Seattle has home-ice advantage and Utah will be without Carcone, the Mammoth have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Kraken can pull it off if they get good looks.

UTA.head: The Mammoth should have the upper hand
UTA.body: Even though Seattle has home-ice advantage and Utah will be without Carcone, the Mammoth have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Kraken’s way back in is getting good looks.

story.head: Who blinks first?
paras: The Kraken are 5-2-1. The Mammoth have won three straight.

It’s strength against strength: the Mammoth are near the top of the league for chance quality, but the Kraken are near the top at preventing dangerous shots. The Mammoth shoot a lot, and the Kraken give up plenty.
